description: NIST's STC-08, its AP242 edition 3's solid #9306 alone (excerpt): the plane-and-torus edge at (67.31, 39.69, 48.26) filleted alone at r 0.5. Arris chains through a vertex tangent within its tolerance (ADR-0075) and refuses `OpError::Internal` ("a kink's junction of two runs was not found"), where before the edge was `Unsupported end` (cylinder against cylinder). Open CASCADE builds it valid (tolerant-tangency step 8's census)
